sources.title: Gemma 4 with quantization-aware training - The Keyword
sources.snippet: Today, we are releasing new checkpoints optimized with Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) to make Gemma 4 even more efficient, so you can run models locally on everyday edge devices and consumer GPUs. By simulating quantization during training, QAT minimizes quality loss when the model is compressed.
